Fig. 5 — One-click launcher

One icon. Every OS. Nothing to install.

A small Go program, built from one source for Windows, macOS and Linux, finds the app files, fetches uv (which brings Python and every dependency), starts the server and shows a live boot screen in the browser until the app answers — then serves the app at that same address.
